title: cinna-agent.json
description: Definitional metadata for a locally built agent. Lives at the agent folder root and travels unchanged into a cloud agent workspace and into bundle revisions. Unknown keys are preserved for forward compatibility.

schema_version.description: Manifest contract version. A tool that does not understand this number must refuse to parse the file.

kit_version.description: Version of the kit that scaffolded this agent. Informational.

slug.description: Folder name and cloud reference. Must equal the agent folder's name.

description.description: One sentence describing what the agent does. Feeds agent cards, the A2A card and router-trigger generation.

example_prompts.description: Ready-to-send task suggestions AND a first-class routing input. At least one is required for a cloud-ready agent.

router_trigger_prompt.description: One capability-verb sentence used only by the routing classifier. Describes when to route here, never how to behave.

prompts.description: Paths, relative to the agent root, of the three document-backed prompts.

status_refresh_command.description: Shell command, or a /run:<name> reference into docs/CLI_COMMANDS.yaml, executed before the platform reads STATUS.md.

credentials.description: Credential slots the agent needs. Never contains secret values.

env_prefix.description: Prefix of the local .env variable names for this slot. Variable name is <env_prefix><FIELD in upper case>.

fields.description: Field names of the credential payload, as the platform names them.

schedules.description: Unattended runs. Declared locally, created on the platform at import time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Local-only metadata used to render the cron description at import.

prompt.description: Required for static_prompt: the message sent to start the run.

command.description: Required for script_trigger: the shell command whose non-OK output starts a session.

handovers.description: Other agents this one may delegate to. Targets are slugs of sibling agents.

features.description: Cloud-only capabilities the agent expects once imported. Ignored locally.

cloud.description: Written only by the cloud import step. Cleared when the agent folder is copied or exported.
